transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Honestly, doctor, I'm here because my mood has been all over the place for the last six months—I'm either incredibly happy or suddenly super irritated. I have this constant, overflowing energy that makes it completely impossible for me to sit still or stop moving. It just feels like I always have to be doing something.

During these periods of high energy and elevated mood, have you ever experienced a time where you became so active or impulsive that it caused serious problems in your life, such as needing hospitalization or being unable to function at work or home?

I'm not really sure, and I haven't really thought about it in terms of causing serious problems or needing hospital care. I just know that I feel extremely overactive all the time and find it completely impossible to rest.
Did you experience these difficulties with focus and high energy during your childhood and school years, or is this something that only started happening more recently?
No, I never experienced anything like this during my childhood or school years. This extreme energy and hyperactivity only started recently, about six months ago.
During the times when your mood is not elevated or energetic, have you experienced periods of feeling deeply sad, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy?
Yes, absolutely. I've had periods where I feel deeply sad, completely empty, and lose all interest in the things I used to enjoy. These down phases have occurred and lasted for about four months.

During your periods of high energy, have you had episodes lasting at least four consecutive days where your mood was elevated or irritable, or have these periods lasted even longer, such as a week or more?

Oh, they definitely last much longer than a week. In fact, these periods of high energy and intense mood shifts have been going on pretty much constantly for about six months now. It doesn't just stop after a few days.

Has there been any point during these six months where your high energy or mood was so severe that it caused significant impairment in your ability to work or maintain your social relationships, or resulted in you needing to be hospitalized?

I'm not really sure if it ever got to the point of severe impairment or needing to be hospitalized. But during those six months, my energy was extremely high and I was constantly active without being able to stop.
During these high-energy periods, did you ever experience symptoms like hearing voices, seeing things that weren't there, or holding beliefs that others found clearly untrue or bizarre?

Yes, I definitely experienced those things, like hearing voices, seeing things that weren't there, and having beliefs that others found really bizarre. However, these experiences only happened during my high-energy, active phases. When I was in my down or depressed periods, none of that ever occurred.

Have you ever experienced these symptoms—like hearing voices or holding those bizarre beliefs—at times when your mood was completely normal and you were not feeling either high-energy or deeply depressed?

No, I've never experienced those things when my mood was normal. They only happen when I am in that extremely high-energy, elevated state. When my mood is normal or when I'm feeling down, those voices and beliefs disappear completely.
